answer: Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The sparrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ivory.
